section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to measure body appreciation on a 1-5 scale. The text explains that the BAS was selected for the research because the BAS-2 had not yet been published at the time of recruitment. The section references prior validation studies with U.S. undergraduate men and U.K. community samples but does not provide specific study data.
